title: One Ocean, Many Tasks: A Data-Grounded Simulation Suite and Benchmark for Marine Robotics

evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: We present OneOcean, a data-grounded simulation suite and benchmark built around a unified spatiotemporal ocean-environment product that harmonizes bathymetry with data-driven currents and tides, with optional pollution fields for cleanup-related evaluation.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: On top of this environment representation, OneOcean defines a task ladder spanning navigation and station-keeping under currents, waypoint and route following, depth-profile tracking, area scanning, pipeline inspection, and multi-agent coordination, including formation transit, fish protection and patrol (herding), and surface pollution localization, containment, and cleanup.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Our simulator supports three to six Degrees of Freedom (DoF) and produces standardized metrics and reproducible run manifests, enabling consistent aggregation across tasks, difficulties, and scaling settings.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Experiments across dataset variants and scenes systematically stress planning and control under data-grounded disturbances and reveal trade-offs among heuristic baselines, Behavior Cloning (BC), and a Large Language Model (LLM)-based planner.
